# Cuprice MCP Server

> Public MCP server for integrating Cuprice pricing widgets from AI tools.

## Tools

- [get-pricing](https://mcp.cuprice.io/#get-pricing): Get public pricing data (plans, features, theme) by Share ID
- [get-embed-code](https://mcp.cuprice.io/#get-embed-code): Get embed snippet for HTML, Next.js, React, or Vue (pricing or billing widget)
- [get-css-classes](https://mcp.cuprice.io/#get-css-classes): Get CSS class names for widget customization

`get-receipt` is deprecated: Stripe checkout was removed, and it now only returns a deprecation notice.

Endpoint: `POST https://mcp.cuprice.io/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, no API key).

## API v1 (Authenticated)

For full CRUD operations, use the REST API with an API key (`Authorization: Bearer cpk_...`):

- [API Overview](https://docs.cuprice.io/api-reference/overview): All endpoints
- [Authentication](https://docs.cuprice.io/api-reference/authentication): API key setup
- Projects: GET/POST /api/v1/projects, GET/PUT/DELETE /api/v1/projects/:slug
- Features: GET/POST /api/v1/projects/:slug/features, PUT/DELETE .../:featureId
- Plans: GET/POST /api/v1/projects/:slug/plans, PUT/DELETE .../:planId, POST .../duplicate
- Plan Features: GET/POST/DELETE /api/v1/projects/:slug/plans/:planId/features
